policyAndCalibration: The saved match-score threshold policy was preserved; no new all-criteria veto was introduced.

Some initial expectations incorrectly required needs_review where the current evidence-complete threshold contract legitimately returned not_shortlisted; the labels were corrected, not hidden by changing production outcomes.
Fractional experience and explicitly current-certification deficit fixtures use threshold 100 to make their full-coverage expectation explicit.

At threshold 80, learning-not-experience returned missing/partial framework evidence but overall scores 82 and 91, so shortlisted was legitimate under the unchanged policy. Its final named fixture retry uses threshold 100 and returns not_shortlisted.

A separate real evidence bug was fixed: an explicitly expired/unrenewed credential alone cannot prove an explicitly current certification requirement. Renewal evidence for the same credential remains considered.
Changed fixture labels/thresholds make pass-count differences unsuitable as a like-for-like model improvement measurement. Original failures remain in their artifacts.
limitations: Assistant-authored synthetic cases and expectations are not independent expert labels, consented candidate training data, hiring accuracy or demographic fairness evidence.
Only twelve newly added resume cases and two existing report cases were measured with two repeats under their latest applicable fixtures; the full thirty-case corpus was not rerun.

Stable outcomes do not establish stable scores or calibrated semantic judgments. Fractional experience ranged 71–86 and unrelated experience 36–71 in the corrected main run; learning ranged 82–91 in the final retry.
Reviewed representative examples and held-out independent evaluation remain required before making production-quality claims.
